commitment.heading: We carry out more than we carry in
commitment.body: Every Ridgeline walk removes rubbish from the track and logs weeds for Parks Victoria. It's a small thing done every week for fifteen years.

seo.defaultTitle: Ridgeline Walks | Guided walks in the Victorian High Country (demo)
seo.defaultDescription: Small group guided walks on the Razorback and Bogong High Plains from Bright, Victoria. A fictional demo site built on the Acceso kit.

hero.headline: Fifteen seasons on the Razorback
hero.support: Small group guided walks above the treeline, from Bright. Six walkers, one guide, no crowds.
hero.alt: Demo placeholder image of an alpine ridge at dawn

positioning.heading: The high country, on foot and at your pace
positioning.body: We've guided the Razorback every summer since 2009. Groups are capped at six so the guide can read the weather, the track and the walkers, and change the plan when the mountain says so.

features.heading: Above the treeline by the second hour
features.body: Most of our routes climb through snow gum woodland and break out onto open ridges before lunch. From there the walking is airy, the views run to the Main Range, and the wind decides the pace.

features.heading: One guide, six walkers
features.body: Small groups mean the guide walks with you, not ahead of you. Ask about the geology, the wildflowers, or just walk in silence for an hour.

offers.heading: Three ways to walk the high country
offers.intro: A three day traverse, a big day walk, and a night on the plains under the stars.

story.heading: Started with one tent and a borrowed ute
story.body:
Sam Demo guided the first Ridgeline walk in January 2009 with three friends, one tent and a borrowed ute. The walks have grown, the groups haven't. Six walkers is still the maximum, because that's the number one guide can genuinely look after on a ridge in changing weather.

Today Ridgeline runs from October to April out of Bright, with two guides who between them have walked the Razorback more than four hundred times.

cta.heading: The ridge is waiting
cta.body: Dates run October to April. Six places per departure.

about.heading: About Ridgeline Walks
about.intro: A two guide operation based in Bright, walking the Razorback and Bogong High Plains since 2009. This is a fictional demo.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.intro: Email is quickest. If we're on the mountain we'll reply that evening.

privateGroups.heading: Private and group walks
privateGroups.intro: Walking clubs, families and workplaces book the whole group. Same guides, your dates.
privateGroups.body: We run private departures of every walk for groups of four to six. For larger clubs we add a second guide.

giftVouchers.heading: Gift a walk
giftVouchers.intro: Vouchers cover any walk and are valid for three years.

gettingThere.notes: We provide transfers from Bright to every trailhead.
